title: Battle of Paye
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Paye", at revision 1370271651, opens: "The Battle of Paye took place during the Philippine–American War between the United States and the Philippines. It was fought on July 31, 1900, at Sitio Paye near Barangay Balimbing in the town of Boac, Marinduque. The short skirmish happened between the reconnaissance forces of Company A, 29th USV under the command of 1st Lieutenant Willam S. Wells and the guerrilla forces of the 2nd Guerilla under the command of Captain Teofilo Navaroso Roque." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q115917545, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle during the Philippine–American War fought on the island of Marinduque". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
